name: Checked Brushed-Cotton Shirt
best_way_to_buy: Favor retailers with free returns given how fit-dependent this category is.

vectors.label: Size & fit
vectors.why_it_matters: Tops are the single most-returned apparel type on true-to-size mismatches; brand sizing is not standardized.

vectors.label: Fit style (slim / relaxed / oversized)
vectors.why_it_matters: Same nominal size drapes very differently by cut, independent of body measurements.

vectors.label: Fabric & care
vectors.why_it_matters: Determines comfort, breathability, wrinkle behavior, and whether it survives frequent washing.

vectors.label: Occasion
vectors.why_it_matters: A work-appropriate blouse and a lounge tee solve different problems even in the same subcategory.

vectors.label: Season & weight
vectors.why_it_matters: Fabric weight determines whether the top is wearable for the season the scenario is set in.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Everyday basics have enormous price spread for near-identical function.

name: Belted Denim Relaxed-Fit Barrel-Leg Pants
best_way_to_buy: Favor retailers with a printed size chart and free returns — fit risk here is high.

vectors.label: Waist & inseam fit
vectors.why_it_matters: The two measurements that actually determine wearability, more reliable than a size label alone.

vectors.label: Rise & silhouette
vectors.why_it_matters: High/mid/low rise and slim/straight/wide leg change comfort and styling independent of size.

vectors.label: Fabric & stretch
vectors.why_it_matters: Stretch percentage drives all-day comfort, especially for jeans and trousers.

vectors.label: Occasion
vectors.why_it_matters: Work trousers, weekend chinos, and going-out skirts aren't interchangeable.

vectors.label: Durability & wash care
vectors.why_it_matters: Bottoms see more wear-and-wash cycles than most apparel; matters more for daily-driver pieces.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread between fast-fashion and durable-denim price points for the same garment type.

name: Smocked Seersucker Mini Dress
best_way_to_buy: Surface return window prominently; this is the highest fit-risk apparel category.

vectors.label: Occasion & formality
vectors.why_it_matters: A cocktail dress, a sundress, and a wrap dress for the office solve unrelated problems.

vectors.label: Size & body fit
vectors.why_it_matters: Dresses combine bust/waist/hip fit simultaneously, so mismatch risk compounds across three measurements.

vectors.label: Fabric & drape
vectors.why_it_matters: Drape determines how the silhouette actually looks on the body, which a flat product photo often misrepresents.

vectors.label: Length & silhouette
vectors.why_it_matters: Mini/midi/maxi and A-line/bodycon/wrap are the main axes of personal style preference in this category.

vectors.label: Season
vectors.why_it_matters: Fabric weight and sleeve length need to match the scenario's timing.

vectors.label: Return policy
vectors.why_it_matters: Highest-return apparel category; a generous return window materially de-risks the purchase.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Dresses and going-out pieces span an unusually wide price range even within one occasion, from fast-fashion to designer.

name: Collarless Wool-Twill Coat
best_way_to_buy: Weight heavily toward weather/warmth specs matching the scenario's actual climate, not just style.

vectors.label: Warmth / insulation rating
vectors.why_it_matters: The primary functional spec — down fill weight or insulation type determines usable temperature range.
vectors.value: No formal rating — fabric: Italian wool-twill, heavyweight

vectors.label: Weather protection
vectors.why_it_matters: Waterproof/windproof rating matters far more here than in any other apparel archetype.

vectors.label: Layering fit
vectors.why_it_matters: Outerwear needs to fit over whatever's worn underneath — sizing runs differently from a standalone top.

vectors.label: Material & durability
vectors.why_it_matters: Outerwear is typically a multi-year purchase, so build quality matters more than in fast-turnover categories.

vectors.label: Weight & packability
vectors.why_it_matters: Relevant for travel or activity use cases where the jacket needs to pack down.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Technical outerwear has a very wide price range tied directly to performance claims.

vectors.label: Gemstone / material authenticity

name: Saffiano Leather Belt

vectors.why_it_matters: Straightforward but essential — the wrong length range makes the item unusable regardless of style.

vectors.label: Material quality (leather vs. synthetic)
vectors.why_it_matters: Drives both longevity and formality level.

vectors.label: Buckle style
vectors.why_it_matters: Primary style-differentiation axis in this category.

vectors.label: Occasion (casual / formal)
vectors.why_it_matters: Casual and formal belts are rarely interchangeable in styling.

vectors.label: Reversibility
vectors.why_it_matters: Reversible belts offer two looks per purchase, a real value consideration.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic to premium leather goods.

name: Waffle-Knit Socks
best_way_to_buy: Compare on price-per-pair across pack sizes, not sticker price.

vectors.label: Size fit (shoe-size based)
vectors.why_it_matters: Sized off shoe size rather than body measurement, and often the wrong axis if bought carelessly.

vectors.label: Activity use (athletic / dress / thermal / everyday)
vectors.why_it_matters: Cushioning, height (ankle/crew/knee), and material all follow from intended use.

vectors.why_it_matters: Cotton, wool, and compression/nylon blends serve different comfort and durability needs.

vectors.label: Pack quantity & value
vectors.why_it_matters: Almost always bought in multi-packs; per-pair price is the meaningful comparison unit.

vectors.label: Durability under wash
vectors.why_it_matters: Heel/toe wear-through is the dominant failure mode; matters for value comparison.

vectors.label: Price tier
vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread from basic multi-packs to technical/compression hosiery.

vectors.label: Face shape fit
vectors.why_it_matters: Frame shape flattering a given face shape is the dominant style-satisfaction driver.
